model_annotation: The two line plots display the IWF Fiskalindex and debt ratios over time from 1995 to 2020, with the left plot showing data for the total state (Gesamtstaat) and the right plot for the central state (Zentralstaat). Both plots share a common x-axis labeled with years from 1995 to 2020 in five-year increments, using a linear scale. The left plot has a primary y-axis on the left labeled "IWF Fiskalindex" ranging from 0 to 2.5 with major gridlines every 0.5 units, and a secondary y-axis on the right labeled "Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat" ranging from 60 to 120 with major gridlines every 20 units. The right plot has a primary y-axis on the left labeled "IWF Fiskalindex" ranging from -0.5 to 2.0 with major gridlines every 0.5 units, and a secondary y-axis on the right labeled "Schuldenquote Zentralstaat" ranging from 30 to 70 with major gridlines every 10 units. In the left plot, the blue line (IWF Fiskalindex) starts near 0 in 1995, rises to approximately 0.45 by 2005, peaks at about 1.0 in 2010, then declines to around 0.5 by 2020. The purple line (Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat) begins near 60 in 1995, gradually increases to about 80 by 2005, rises sharply to approximately 100 by 2015, and reaches about 110 by 2020. The blue triangles represent a threshold or target value for the IWF Fiskalindex, consistently at 1.0 from 1995 to 2005, then at 1.5 from 2006 to 2010, and at 2.0 from 2011 to 2020. The red triangles represent a threshold for the Schuldenquote Gesamtstaat, remaining constant at 80 from 1995 to 2005, then at 90 from 2006 to 2010, and at 100 from 2011 to 2020. In the right plot, the blue line (IWF Fiskalindex) starts near 0 in 1995, fluctuates between -0.5 and 0.5 until 2008, rises sharply to about 1.0 in 2010, then declines to near 0 by 2017, and increases again to approximately 0.6 by 2020. The purple line (Schuldenquote Zentralstaat) begins near 35 in 1995, rises to about 40 by 2005, increases sharply to approximately 50 by 2010, remains relatively stable until 2017, and then rises steeply to about 70 by 2020. The blue triangles represent a threshold for the IWF Fiskalindex, consistently at 0.9 from 1995 to 2005, then at 1.4 from 2006 to 2009, and at 2.0 from 2010 to 2020. The red triangles represent a threshold for the Schuldenquote Zentralstaat, remaining constant at 35 from 1995 to 2005, then at 40 from 2006 to 2009, and at 50 from 2010 to 2020.
